headline: Tesla Q3 profit drops as automaker prepares for potential SpaceX merger
summary: Tesla reported a drop in third-quarter profit while beating analyst estimates, as the electric vehicle maker prepares for a possible merger with Elon Musk's SpaceX.
why: Corporate earnings reports and major structural changes like potential mergers provide critical insights into a company's financial health and valuation prospects for investors.

impacts.name: Tesla
impacts.why: Profits declined year-over-year, but results still managed to top broader Wall Street analyst consensus estimates.

why_moved: Earnings figures that surpassed consensus estimates helped cushion the blow of lower year-over-year quarterly profits.
